title: The New Teen Titans
description: New Teen Titans was an ongoing comic book series which began publication in 1980 and featured the super-hero team the Teen Titans. DC Comics revived the Teen Titans in the pages of DC Comics Presents #26. Joining the team was the former Doom Patrol associate known as Beast Boy (now calling himself Changeling), and three entirely new characters named Raven, Starfire and Cyborg. These new heroes united with Robin, Kid Flash and Wonder Girl to form, the New Teen Titans.
author: Marv Wolfman, George Pérez
